description: Rewrites the text of a lead's upcoming step that a person sends, from the conversation so far, as the journey's Update draft does (one AI draft, billed like the composer's Draft). Refused for a call step, a step Sergio sends on its own, or a step already past. Nothing is sent. task_id is the lead (read entity tasks); step_id is the step's id from the lead's journey. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: redraft_lead_step
title: Redraft a lead's upcoming text step
